text:
maria: quick heads-up — i poked at the token-proof queue today. looks like the handshake currently emits two audit events per request (claim + finalize) and that doubles keys downstream in some race paths.

devin: ugh, yea that's been causing double-charges when handback races with a replay. seen in the east-1 canary the other night.

sam: can we collapse to a single 'finalized' audit and make claim ephemeral? that feels cleaner.

agnes: i'm wary — dashboards rely on the claim event to show inflight credits in realtime. losing it could make UI confusing.

maria: proposal: keep claim as a local, sidecar-level transient (no external fanout). emit one canonical `finalized` event for billing/ledger. store a tiny 24h claim->final mapping in a compact TTL store for replay protection.

devin: how do late arrivals / backfills work then? we still need provenance to reconstruct what happened.

maria: add a minimal `proof_path` array on the finalized event with compact fingerprints (e.g., [req_hash, prefix_hash, final_hash]) — enough to replay and stitch without carrying the full claim payload. this keeps event size small.

sam: also add a `replay_source` enum (live|backfill) so billing can treat backfills idempotently.

metering-bot: deploy-preview: branch `tokenproof/compact-finalize` pushed; CI ✅ — cc @maria @devin for review.

agnes: tests? need a deterministic sim that reproduces the race stack so we can assert "no duplicate final charges".

maria: local sim: `./scripts/simulate_tokenseq.sh --races 1000 --seed 42` — it reproduces the double-finalize pattern. i'll add an assertion harness.

devin: storage/cost-wise a 3-hash proof_path per event seems fine. we'll run numbers but it's smaller than full claim.

sam: migration: we should run a 30-day mirror mode where we emit both events (old claim + new finalized) and add header `x-metering-mirror:true` so consumers can opt-in to test. after 30d flip to single-event mode.

maria: agree. also add a compatibility flag in the sidecar to enable mirror -> single transition per-tenant.

devin: timeline idea: 3 days for RFC + schema, 2 days for tests & canary, 7 days mirror in staging, then prod canary for a week.

agnes: i'll coordinate dashboards and alerts: will watch for unexpected reimburse spikes. also will notify analytics to switch joins to finalized event once mirror looks stable.

sam: don't forget to update the audit-replay tooling to use `proof_path` if present, fallback to claim-store if not.

maria: ok i'll open an RFC follow-up with explicit event schema, sample payloads, migration plan, and backfill playbook. tagging @all — will attach sim logs and canary checklist.

devin: thanks — LGTM.

sam: :thumbsup:
